div.head: Hn Lond 1
div.ab: Sciatis me concessisse civibus meis Londoniarum tenendum Middlesexe ad firmam pro CCC libris ad compotem, ipsis et heredibus suis de me et heredibus meis, ita quod ipsi cives ponent vicecomitem, qualem voluerint, de se ipsis et iusticia[m], qualem voluerint, de se ipsis ad custodienda placita coronae meae et ad eadem placitanda; et nullus alius erit iusticia super ipsos homines Londoniarum.

Be it known to you that I have granted Middlesex to my citizens of London to be held on lease by them and their heirs of me and my heirs for £300 paid by tale, upon these terms: that the citizens themselves appoint a sheriff, such as they desire, from among themselves, and a justiciar, such as they desire, from among themselves, to safeguard the pleas of my crown and to conduct such pleas. And there shall be no other justiciar over the men of London.
